**Uninstall games and apps**
- SD card screen > "Uninstall games and apps" lists everything in /PALM/Launcher (apps) and /PALM/Programs (game data) and removes the one you pick, including whole data folders. Free space on the card is reclaimed. A game normally has an app file and a data folder; remove both.
- The Zodiac sees the change the next time it starts (the card is re-inserted automatically).

Includes the install fix (v0.12): zip data goes under /PALM/Programs, Mac junk files skipped.
